## Specification

### Component: Sheet

A panel that slides in from an edge while the page stays visible behind it. Built on the native `<dialog>` element (`showModal()`) exactly like Dialog: top layer, focus containment and an inert page come from the browser.

#### Anatomy
```
<Sheet>                       context: open state, ids
  <SheetTrigger />            button, aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded
  <SheetContent>              <dialog class="ui-sheet" data-side data-state> fills the viewport
    (overlay)                 .ui-sheet::before — fades on its own
    .ui-sheet-panel           the sliding surface (mounted only after showModal())
      .ui-sheet-handle        bottom sheets only, aria-hidden, drag surface
      (close ×)               .ui-sheet-close, aria-label="Close"
      <SheetHeader>           .ui-sheet-header
        <SheetTitle />        <h2> → aria-labelledby
        <SheetDescription />  <p>  → aria-describedby
      <SheetBody />           .ui-sheet-body — flex 1, scrolls
      <SheetFooter />         .ui-sheet-footer — column-reverse on phones, row end ≥ 640px
      <SheetClose />
```

#### Props
- `Sheet`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`.
- `SheetContent`: `side` (`right` default | `left` | `top` | `bottom`), `size` (`sm` 320 · `md` 400 · `lg` 520 · `xl` 640 · `full`; for top/bottom it is the max width: size + 224px), `dismissible` (default true), `showClose` (default true), `showHandle` (bottom, default true), `mobileFull` (left/right fill the width below 640px), `panelClassName`.
- `SheetTrigger` / `SheetClose`: buttons; `asChild`.

#### Behaviour
- Same lifecycle as Dialog: `showModal()`, then mount the panel (so `autoFocus` works), scroll lock, focus to `[autofocus]` else the panel, focus returns to the trigger after the exit animation.
- Esc (`cancel`) is intercepted so closing animates; ignored when not dismissible. A press and release on the overlay (the `<dialog>` itself) closes.
- Bottom sheet drag (pointer events on `.ui-sheet-handle`, `touch-action: none`): the panel follows the pointer downward (never upward); `data-dragging` is set on the dialog and `--ui-sheet-progress` (0–1) fades the overlay. On release: dismiss when the offset exceeds 35% of the panel height or the release velocity (last 100ms) exceeds 0.6px/ms (and offset > 8px); the panel keeps its position so the exit animation continues from there. Otherwise it springs back on `--ui-spring-smooth`.

#### Visual rules
- Overlay: `--ui-overlay` + `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)`, drawn by `::before`.
- Panel: `--ui-surface-raised`, `--ui-shadow-lg`, 1px `--ui-border` on the inner edge. Side sheets: full height, width `min(size, 100vw − 48px)`, square corners. Bottom: `--radius-xl` top corners, max height 90dvh, bottom padding for the safe area. Top: mirror.
- Header padding 20/56/16/24px, title 17px/600, description 14px muted. Body padding 4/24/16px, gap 16px. Footer padding 16/24px, 1px `--ui-border-subtle` top border.
- Handle: 40×5px pill `--ui-border-strong`, in a 10/6px padded drag surface.

#### Motion
- Open: panel `ui-slide-in-<side>` for `--ui-spring-smooth-duration` (540ms) with `--ui-spring-smooth` (no overshoot); overlay `ui-fade-in` 380ms.
- Close: panel `ui-slide-out-<side>` 200ms `--ui-ease-in`, overlay fade 160ms; pointer events off.
- Reduced motion: state changes, no movement (global rule).

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA modal dialog pattern. Title/description ids only when rendered. Dragging is an enhancement; Esc and the close button always work.

#### Acceptance checks
- Slides from the chosen edge without overshoot; overlay fades separately from the panel.
- Esc and overlay click close it; focus returns to the trigger; page does not scroll behind.
- Bottom sheet: small drag springs back, long drag or flick dismisses.
- Phones: `mobileFull` fills the width; otherwise a strip of overlay stays visible.

### `ui/components/sheet/sheet.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type DialogHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDragDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-drag-dismiss';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { useScrollLock } from '../../hooks/use-scroll-lock';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

interface SheetContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  contentId: string;
  titleId: string;
  descriptionId: string;
  hasTitle: boolean;
  hasDescription: boolean;
  setHasTitle: (v: boolean) => void;
  setHasDescription: (v: boolean) => void;
  /** The trigger, so focus can return to it (Safari/Firefox do not focus buttons on click). */
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
}

const SheetContext = createContext<SheetContextValue | null>(null);

function useSheetContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(SheetContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Sheet>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SheetProps {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the sheet asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Sheet — a panel that slides in from an edge for focused work that should
 * keep the page in view. Built on native <dialog> like Dialog: top layer,
 * focus containment and an inert page come from the browser.
 */
export function Sheet({ open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, children }: SheetProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const [hasTitle, setHasTitle] = useState(false);
  const [hasDescription, setHasDescription] = useState(false);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  return (
    <SheetContext.Provider
      value={{
        open,
        setOpen,
        contentId: `${id}-content`,
        titleId: `${id}-title`,
        descriptionId: `${id}-description`,
        hasTitle,
        hasDescription,
        setHasTitle,
        setHasDescription,
        triggerRef,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </SheetContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SheetTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** Opens the sheet. Use `asChild` to make your own <Button> the trigger. */
export const SheetTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SheetTriggerProps>(function SheetTrigger(
  { asChild, onClick, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useSheetContext('SheetTrigger');
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, ctx.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>);
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={composed}
      type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
      aria-haspopup="dialog"
      aria-expanded={ctx.open}
      aria-controls={ctx.open ? ctx.contentId : undefined}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.setOpen(true);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type SheetSide = 'right' | 'left' | 'top' | 'bottom';
export type SheetSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full';

export interface SheetContentProps extends Omit<DialogHTMLAttributes<HTMLDialogElement>, 'open'> {
  /** Edge the sheet slides in from. Default `right`. */
  side?: SheetSide;
  /** Width of a side sheet (320 / 400 / 520 / 640px) or max width of a top/bottom sheet. Default `md`. */
  size?: SheetSize;
  /** Close on Esc and overlay click. Default true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Show the × button in the corner. Default true. */
  showClose?: boolean;
  /** Grab handle + drag-to-dismiss on a bottom sheet. Default true. */
  showHandle?: boolean;
  /** Let a left/right sheet fill the whole screen width on phones. Default false. */
  mobileFull?: boolean;
  /** Class for the inner panel. `className` styles the overlay layer. */
  panelClassName?: string;
}

export const SheetContent = forwardRef<HTMLDialogElement, SheetContentProps>(function SheetContent(
  {
    side = 'right',
    size = 'md',
    dismissible = true,
    showClose = true,
    showHandle = true,
    mobileFull = false,
    className,
    panelClassName,
    children,
    onCancel,
    onClick,
    onPointerDown,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useSheetContext('SheetContent');
  const { mounted, state, ref: presenceRef } = usePresence<HTMLDialogElement>(ctx.open);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, presenceRef);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const returnFocusRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const downOnBackdrop = useRef(false);
  // The panel mounts only after showModal(), so React's `autoFocus` (which runs
  // when an element mounts) lands on a visible element inside the open sheet.
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useScrollLock(ctx.open);

  const close = useCallback(() => ctx.setOpen(false), [ctx]);
  const draggable = side === 'bottom' && showHandle;
  const drag = useDragDismiss({ side, enabled: draggable, panelRef, layerRef: presenceRef, onDismiss: close });

  // 1. Open as a modal in the top layer.
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const dialog = presenceRef.current;
    if (!mounted || !ctx.open || !dialog || dialog.open) return;
    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    returnFocusRef.current = active && active !== document.body ? active : ctx.triggerRef.current;
    dialog.showModal();
    setReady(true);
  }, [mounted, ctx.open]);

  // 2. Once the content is in: keep an autoFocus'd field, else focus the panel.
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !ctx.open) return;
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (!panel) return;
    const auto = panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[autofocus], [data-autofocus]');
    if (auto && document.activeElement !== auto) auto.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    else if (!panel.contains(document.activeElement)) panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [ready, ctx.open]);

  // 3. After the exit animation unmounts the sheet, give focus back.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mounted) return;
    setReady(false);
    const el = returnFocusRef.current;
    returnFocusRef.current = null;
    if (el?.isConnected) el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [mounted]);

  if (!mounted) return null;

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      id={ctx.contentId}
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby={ctx.hasTitle ? ctx.titleId : undefined}
      aria-describedby={ctx.hasDescription ? ctx.descriptionId : undefined}
      data-state={state}
      data-side={side}
      className={cn('ui-sheet', size !== 'md' && `ui-sheet-${size}`, mobileFull && 'ui-sheet-mobile-full', className)}
      onCancel={(e) => {
        onCancel?.(e);
        // Esc: animate out instead of the browser's instant close
        e.preventDefault();
        if (dismissible) close();
      }}
      onPointerDown={(e) => {
        onPointerDown?.(e);
        downOnBackdrop.current = e.target === e.currentTarget;
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        // The <dialog> fills the viewport; a click on it (not the panel) is an overlay click
        if (dismissible && downOnBackdrop.current && e.target === e.currentTarget) close();
        downOnBackdrop.current = false;
      }}
      onClose={() => {
        // Closed natively (e.g. <form method="dialog">) — keep state in sync
        if (ctx.open) close();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {ready && (
        <div ref={panelRef} className={cn('ui-sheet-panel', panelClassName)} tabIndex={-1}>
          {draggable && <div className="ui-sheet-handle" aria-hidden="true" {...drag} />}
          {showClose && (
            <SheetClose className="ui-sheet-close" aria-label="Close">
              <Icon name="x" />
            </SheetClose>
          )}
          {children}
        </div>
      )}
    </dialog>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SheetCloseProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** Closes the sheet. Wrap your own button with `asChild`. */
export const SheetClose = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SheetCloseProps>(function SheetClose(
  { asChild, onClick, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useSheetContext('SheetClose');
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={ref}
      type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.setOpen(false);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export const SheetHeader = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SheetHeader(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sheet-header', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const SheetTitle = forwardRef<HTMLHeadingElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>>(function SheetTitle(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useSheetContext('SheetTitle');
  const { setHasTitle } = ctx;
  useEffect(() => {
    setHasTitle(true);
    return () => setHasTitle(false);
  }, [setHasTitle]);
  return <h2 ref={ref} id={ctx.titleId} className={cn('ui-sheet-title', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const SheetDescription = forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(
  function SheetDescription({ className, ...props }, ref) {
    const ctx = useSheetContext('SheetDescription');
    const { setHasDescription } = ctx;
    useEffect(() => {
      setHasDescription(true);
      return () => setHasDescription(false);
    }, [setHasDescription]);
    return <p ref={ref} id={ctx.descriptionId} className={cn('ui-sheet-description', className)} {...props} />;
  },
);

/** Scrolls on its own when the content is taller than the sheet; header and footer stay put. */
export const SheetBody = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SheetBody(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sheet-body', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const SheetFooter = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function SheetFooter(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sheet-footer', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-drag-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type PointerEvent, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DragSide = 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left';

const AXIS: Record<DragSide, { axis: 'x' | 'y'; sign: 1 | -1 }> = {
  bottom: { axis: 'y', sign: 1 },
  top: { axis: 'y', sign: -1 },
  right: { axis: 'x', sign: 1 },
  left: { axis: 'x', sign: -1 },
};

export interface UseDragDismissOptions {
  /** The edge the panel is docked to; dragging toward it dismisses. */
  side: DragSide;
  enabled?: boolean;
  /** The panel that follows the pointer. */
  panelRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  /** Layer that gets `data-dragging` and `--ui-sheet-progress` (0–1) while dragging. */
  layerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  /** Fraction of the panel size that dismisses on release. Default .35. */
  threshold?: number;
  /** Release velocity (px/ms) that dismisses regardless of distance. Default .6. */
  velocity?: number;
}

/**
 * Drag a panel toward its edge to dismiss it (pointer events, so mouse, touch
 * and pen all work). Release past the threshold or with a quick flick and
 * `onDismiss` fires, leaving the panel where it is so the close animation
 * continues from there; otherwise the panel springs back. Spread the returned
 * handlers on the drag surface (it needs `touch-action: none`).
 */
export function useDragDismiss({
  side,
  enabled = true,
  panelRef,
  layerRef,
  onDismiss,
  threshold = 0.35,
  velocity = 0.6,
}: UseDragDismissOptions) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const drag = useRef<{ id: number; start: number; size: number; samples: { t: number; v: number }[] } | null>(null);
  const { axis, sign } = AXIS[side];

  const set = (offset: number, size: number) => {
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.style.transform = offset ? (axis === 'y' ? `translateY(${sign * offset}px)` : `translateX(${sign * offset}px)`) : '';
    layerRef.current?.style.setProperty('--ui-sheet-progress', String(Math.min(1, offset / size)));
  };

  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (!enabled || e.button > 0 || !panelRef.current) return;
      const rect = panelRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const start = axis === 'y' ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
      drag.current = { id: e.pointerId, start, size: axis === 'y' ? rect.height : rect.width, samples: [{ t: e.timeStamp, v: start }] };
      e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      layerRef.current?.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
    },
    [enabled, axis, panelRef, layerRef],
  );

  const onPointerMove = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const d = drag.current;
      if (!d || d.id !== e.pointerId) return;
      const pos = axis === 'y' ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
      d.samples.push({ t: e.timeStamp, v: pos });
      if (d.samples.length > 8) d.samples.shift();
      const delta = (pos - d.start) * sign;
      // Dragging away from the edge does nothing: the panel never leaves its resting place that way
      set(delta > 0 ? delta : 0, d.size);
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [axis, sign],
  );

  const end = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>, cancelled: boolean) => {
      const d = drag.current;
      if (!d || d.id !== e.pointerId) return;
      drag.current = null;
      const layer = layerRef.current;
      layer?.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
      const pos = axis === 'y' ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
      const offset = Math.max(0, (pos - d.start) * sign);
      // Velocity over the last ~100ms of movement
      const last = d.samples[d.samples.length - 1]!;
      const first = d.samples.find((s) => last.t - s.t <= 100) ?? last;
      const v = last.t > first.t ? ((last.v - first.v) * sign) / (last.t - first.t) : 0;
      if (!cancelled && offset > 8 && (offset > d.size * threshold || v > velocity)) {
        cb.current();
        // Controlled sheet that stays open: spring back instead of hanging half-way
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (layerRef.current?.getAttribute('data-state') === 'open') set(0, d.size);
        }, 80);
      } else {
        set(0, d.size);
      }
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [axis, sign, threshold, velocity, layerRef],
  );

  return {
    onPointerDown,
    onPointerMove,
    onPointerUp: (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => end(e, false),
    onPointerCancel: (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => end(e, true),
  };
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/hooks/use-presence.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { animationsFinished } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Keeps an element mounted until its exit animation has finished.
 *   const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence(open);
 *   {mounted && <div ref={ref} data-state={state} />}
 * CSS animates on [data-state="open" | "closed"]; nothing else is needed.
 */
export function usePresence<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(present: boolean) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(present);
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (present) {
      setMounted(true);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(ref.current).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setMounted(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [present]);

  return {
    mounted: present || mounted,
    state: (present ? 'open' : 'closed') as 'open' | 'closed',
    ref,
  };
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-scroll-lock.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

let locks = 0;
let saved: { overflow: string; paddingRight: string } | null = null;

/** Lock page scroll while `active` (ref-counted, keeps the scrollbar gap). */
export function useScrollLock(active: boolean) {
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (locks++ === 0) {
      const gap = window.innerWidth - root.clientWidth;
      saved = { overflow: root.style.overflow, paddingRight: root.style.paddingRight };
      root.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      if (gap > 0) root.style.paddingRight = `${gap}px`;
    }
    return () => {
      if (--locks === 0 && saved) {
        root.style.overflow = saved.overflow;
        root.style.paddingRight = saved.paddingRight;
        saved = null;
      }
    };
  }, [active]);
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/sheet.css`

```css
/* Sheet -------------------------------------------------------------------
   <dialog class="ui-sheet" data-side="right|left|top|bottom" data-state="open|closed">
     ::before                                              overlay (fades on its own)
     <div class="ui-sheet-panel">                          the sliding surface
       .ui-sheet-handle (bottom only)  .ui-sheet-close
       .ui-sheet-header > .ui-sheet-title + .ui-sheet-description
       .ui-sheet-body (scrolls)  .ui-sheet-footer
   Sizes: .ui-sheet-sm | (md) | .ui-sheet-lg | .ui-sheet-xl | .ui-sheet-full
   Phones: .ui-sheet-mobile-full makes a left/right sheet fill the screen
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@keyframes ui-sheet-overlay-out { to { opacity: 0; } }

@layer components {
  .ui-sheet {
    --ui-sheet-width: 25rem;
    --ui-sheet-progress: 0;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
  }
  .ui-sheet[open] {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .ui-sheet-sm { --ui-sheet-width: 20rem; }
  .ui-sheet-lg { --ui-sheet-width: 32.5rem; }
  .ui-sheet-xl { --ui-sheet-width: 40rem; }
  .ui-sheet-full { --ui-sheet-width: 100vw; }

  .ui-sheet[data-side="right"] { justify-items: end; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="left"] { justify-items: start; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="top"] { justify-items: center; align-items: start; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="bottom"] { justify-items: center; align-items: end; }

  /* Overlay: a pseudo-element, so the panel does not fade with it */
  .ui-sheet::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--ui-overlay);
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    opacity: calc(1 - var(--ui-sheet-progress));
  }
  .ui-sheet:not([data-dragging])::before { transition: opacity var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out); }
  .ui-sheet[data-state="open"]::before { animation: ui-fade-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) backwards; }
  .ui-sheet[data-state="closed"]::before { animation: ui-sheet-overlay-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) forwards; }
  .ui-sheet[data-state="closed"] { pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-sheet-panel {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    outline: none;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }
  .ui-sheet:not([data-dragging]) .ui-sheet-panel {
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth);
  }

  /* Side sheets: full height, a width, a border on the inner edge */
  .ui-sheet[data-side="right"] .ui-sheet-panel,
  .ui-sheet[data-side="left"] .ui-sheet-panel {
    width: min(var(--ui-sheet-width), calc(100vw - 3rem));
    height: 100%;
  }
  .ui-sheet-full[data-side="right"] .ui-sheet-panel,
  .ui-sheet-full[data-side="left"] .ui-sheet-panel { width: 100%; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="right"] .ui-sheet-panel { border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ui-border); }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="left"] .ui-sheet-panel { border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--ui-border); }

  /* Top / bottom sheets: as tall as the content (up to 90% of the screen), capped width */
  .ui-sheet[data-side="top"] .ui-sheet-panel,
  .ui-sheet[data-side="bottom"] .ui-sheet-panel {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: calc(var(--ui-sheet-width) + 14rem);
    max-height: 90dvh;
  }
  .ui-sheet-full[data-side="top"] .ui-sheet-panel,
  .ui-sheet-full[data-side="bottom"] .ui-sheet-panel { max-width: none; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="bottom"] .ui-sheet-panel {
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-bottom: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0 0;
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0);
  }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="top"] .ui-sheet-panel {
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-top: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl);
  }

  @media (max-width: 639px) {
    .ui-sheet-mobile-full[data-side="right"] .ui-sheet-panel,
    .ui-sheet-mobile-full[data-side="left"] .ui-sheet-panel { width: 100%; border-inline: 0; }
  }

  /* Motion: panels slide on the smooth spring (never overshoots); exits are quicker */
  .ui-sheet[data-state="open"] .ui-sheet-panel {
    animation: var(--ui-sheet-in, ui-slide-in-right) var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth) backwards;
  }
  .ui-sheet[data-state="closed"] .ui-sheet-panel {
    animation: var(--ui-sheet-out, ui-slide-out-right) 200ms var(--ui-ease-in) forwards;
  }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="right"] { --ui-sheet-in: ui-slide-in-right; --ui-sheet-out: ui-slide-out-right; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="left"] { --ui-sheet-in: ui-slide-in-left; --ui-sheet-out: ui-slide-out-left; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="top"] { --ui-sheet-in: ui-slide-in-top; --ui-sheet-out: ui-slide-out-top; }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="bottom"] { --ui-sheet-in: ui-slide-in-bottom; --ui-sheet-out: ui-slide-out-bottom; }

  /* Grab handle: a generous drag surface with a small visible pill */
  .ui-sheet-handle {
    flex: none;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0.625rem 0 0.375rem;
    cursor: grab;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  .ui-sheet-handle::before {
    content: "";
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 0.3125rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--ui-border-strong);
  }
  .ui-sheet[data-dragging] .ui-sheet-handle { cursor: grabbing; }

  .ui-sheet-header { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 1.25rem 3.5rem 1rem 1.5rem; flex: none; }
  .ui-sheet-title { font-family: var(--ui-font-display); font-size: var(--text-lg); line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .ui-sheet-description { font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-sheet-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0.25rem 1.5rem 1rem; font-size: var(--text-base); display: grid; gap: 1rem; align-content: start; }
  .ui-sheet-footer {
    flex: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    padding-bottom: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0));
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle);
  }
  @media (min-width: 640px) { .ui-sheet-footer { flex-direction: row; justify-content: flex-end; } }

  .ui-sheet-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    z-index: 2;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 1.75rem;
    height: 1.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-sheet[data-side="bottom"] .ui-sheet-close { top: 1.25rem; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-sheet-close:hover { background: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-sheet-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 75%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }
}
```

## Usage

**Settings sheet** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/sheet/settings.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Sheet, SheetBody, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger } from '@/ui/components/sheet';

const field = 'h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 text-base outline-none focus:border-ring';

const channels = [
  ['Deploy finished', 'Email when a production deploy succeeds or fails.', true],
  ['Weekly summary', 'A Monday digest of traffic and errors.', true],
  ['Billing alerts', 'Invoices, failed payments and plan changes.', false],
] as const;

export default function SheetSettings() {
  return (
    <Sheet>
      <SheetTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">Notification settings</Button>
      </SheetTrigger>
      <SheetContent>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>Notification settings</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>Choose what we send to ada@atlas.dev.</SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetBody>
          <label className="grid gap-1.5 text-base font-medium">
            Reply-to address
            <input className={field} defaultValue="team@atlas.dev" autoFocus />
          </label>
          <fieldset className="grid gap-3">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-base font-medium">Email me about</legend>
            {channels.map(([label, hint, on]) => (
              <label key={label} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked={on} className="mt-0.5 size-4 accent-primary" />
                <span className="grid">
                  <span className="font-medium">{label}</span>
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">{hint}</span>
                </span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
        </SheetBody>
        <SheetFooter>
          <SheetClose asChild>
            <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
          </SheetClose>
          <SheetClose asChild>
            <Button>Save changes</Button>
          </SheetClose>
        </SheetFooter>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```
